comment: DUMMY DATA — IA skeleton for founder review. One row per page. Agents read this file, filter by version+status, pick a node, work it, flip status. Bands use WORDS, not L-numbers: L0-L5 already means change-cascade levels in holding/HIERARCHY.md and build layers in D38. 'projects_to' = secondary-altitude cross-links (a concept can live on one page but project onto another band, e.g. BLUEPRINT is a PLATFORM mechanism that also surfaces as a DOWNSTREAM skill).
